title: Realtime Ripple
content:
**Ripple** is Photon's native pulse. Built directly on the **Bun WebSocket kernel**, it delivers a sub-millisecond broadcasting layer for public, private, and presence-aware real-time interactions.

The Realtime Matrix

Ripple manages the delicate handshake between the HTTP lifecycle and persistent WebSocket connections with zero overhead, synchronizing state across distributed nodes using a Laravel Echo-inspired API.

BUN_NATIVE

Leverages Bun's high-performance C++ WebSocket implementation for maximum connection density.

PRESENCE_SYNC

Built-in metadata sync for chat and collaboration. Track user states and "typing" indicators automatically.

SENTINEL_INTEGRATED

Directly integrated with the Sentinel Auth kernel for seamless channel authorization and token validation.

Installation

Ripple consists of a server-side kernel module and a universal client SDK.

# Server Kernel
bun add @gravito/ripple

# Client SDK (Universal)
bun add @gravito/ripple-client

Server Synchronization

Install the Ripple module into your PlanetCore instance to enable WebSocket handling.

import { OrbitRipple } from '@gravito/ripple'

core.install(new OrbitRipple({
  path: '/ripple',
  authorizer: async (channel, userId) => {
    // Authorization Logic
    if (channel.startsWith('private-')) {
      return userId !== undefined
    }
    return true
  }
}))

Broadcasting Logic

Trigger events from controllers, models, or internal services.

// 1. Fluent Broadcaster
Broadcaster.to('public.news').emit('Headline', { title: 'Photon v2 released' })

// 2. Encapsulated Event Classes
class MessageSent extends BroadcastEvent {
  constructor(public message: string) { super() }
  
  broadcastOn() {
    return new PrivateChannel(`chat.${this.roomId}`)
  }
}

Channel Archetypes

PUBLIC

Open access. Ideal for global system notifications, stock prices, or live scores.

PRIVATE

Requires auth. Secure delivery for user-specific data, orders, or secure notifications.

PRESENCE

Private + State. Tracks who is online. Perfect for multiplayer games or collaborative tools.

Multi-Framework Client Integration

Ripple provides purpose-built wrappers for all modern frontend stacks.

// 1. Vanilla JavaScript
import { createRippleClient } from '@gravito/ripple-client'
const client = createRippleClient('ws://api.photon.dev/ripple')

client.channel('public.news').listen('Headline', (data) => console.log(data))

// 2. React Hooks
const { members, typing } = usePresence('chat.lobby')

// 3. Vue Composables
const { channel } = useRipple('orders.123')
channel.on('Shipped', (status) => notify(status))

// RIPPLE_SPEC: KERNEL_UPGRADE_HANDOFF

Ripple handles the HTTP-to-WebSocket upgrade protocol directly at the adapter layer. This allows Photon to maintain a single port for both RESTful APIs and real-time streams without complex proxy configurations.

Performance Metrics

Broadcasting throughput and connection density analysis.

RIPPLE_BUN_NATIVE ~80k Concurrent (1GB RAM)
LEGACY_SOCKET_IO ~4k Concurrent (1GB RAM)

**Architect's Insight:** Real-time isn't just about speed; it's about reliability at scale. By embedding Ripple directly into the Photon kernel, we eliminate the proxy-induced latency of external message brokers for small-to-mid scale deployments.
